decisions.statement: This module is the only place the watcher worker's collaborators are chosen.
The start is handed a collaborator rather than reaching for a collaborator.
The process shell the start refuses to hold is held here.
An exit the start answers is carried out here.
A signal handler is installed here rather than in the start.
The queue running uploads in turn runs each upload after the upload before that upload ends.
An upload that throws leaves the queue ready for the next upload.
The checkout the running version is read from is the one this module runs from.
The session is opened once and every later reader takes that same session.
A reader taken before the session is open is refused.
The account a run outcome is reported under is read off the open session.
The session is the watcher's enrolment token checked against the page store.
The account the session names is the account that enrolment names.
A token the store matches to no enrolment answers a session with no user.
A token that will not read answers a session with no user.
The token is checked once rather than on every ask.
Nothing here signs anyone in through a browser.
Nothing here decides the watcher's handling of a file that watcher read.

definition: the collaborators a watcher worker runs on, chosen and handed to the start
